meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar **active pimples, blackheads ya whiteheads** hain, toh ₹700 ke andar meri first choice **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** hai—price usually ₹500–₹550 ke aas-paas milta hai.[1][2]

- **Best for active acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum — raat mein **alternate days**, 2–3 drops.
- **Budget option:** The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Serum — 2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide, lagbhag ₹449.[2]
- **Sirf acne marks/oiliness ke liye:** The Derma Co 10% Niacinamide — lagbhag ₹187–₹222.[1][2]
- **Red acne marks/pigmentation ke liye:** 10% azelaic acid serum — Derma Decode option lagbhag ₹587.[1]

**Kaise use karein:** Cleanser ke baad serum, phir moisturizer. Din mein SPF 30+ sunscreen zaroor lagayein. Shuruaat mein salicylic acid ko daily na lagayein aur ek saath multiple active serums use na karein, warna irritation ho sakti hai.[4]

Deep, painful acne, scars, ya 8–12 hafton mein improvement na ho toh dermatologist ko dikhayein.[4] Prices offers ke hisaab se badal sakte hain.
